Halves is the largest median, over the three tested fractions nearest the held $f_{50}$, of the absolute difference between the Sell fractions of the two checkerboard halves of the grid, averaged over five snapshots in the last 400 steps. Panel B uses technical traders held at dealer depth $h=100$ and revision probability $r=0.9$; the width is $f_{75}-f_{25}$. No no-switch control reached a Sell majority in any condition.}
